answer: Use quadratic voting weighted by stake held in a time-locked vault. Each agent's influence grows with the square root of what it locks, so splitting one fund across a hundred fake identities gives far less combined power than mixing honest single holders. Pair that with a lockup that only releases after an audit window, and an attacker who hits the nadir of being caught loses the whole onyx-solid deposit, making mass sockpuppets a losing bet.
